study: Source-only eligibility audit of eight existing nonlocal onset/burst descriptors
purpose: Resolve the historical28 eligibility gap, not rescue a failed supervised search. Distinguish static record descriptors, formula reproducibility, valid-window support, Raw250 comparability and channel-order artifacts before any later candidate admission.
forbidden: new Outer or original Development results
patient or window selection for favorable quality
identity: Require exact frozen feature-cache/reconstruction/pool-registry bindings; unique original compound record keys, canonical channel/name/order identities, exact saved times/masks and unchanged original fivefold patient-role arrays. Select only the original80/256 intersection of the larger feature cache. Raw waveforms are not reloaded/re-extracted.
formula_replay: AST-load only pure source functions, not the historical builder CLI or its label-validation/split functions. Recompute all eight from the stored20 base features and stored centers by name. Count exact equality and a secondary original-style tolerance8float32ULP+2e-6absoluteReference, with no fixed absolute floor. Never waive exact failures or equate numeric replay with cache-creation provenance.
broadcast_and_delta: Verify each record/channel field is constant over time, including all valid positions. Report pre-subtraction residuals and floating roundoff, but never treat zero/numerical DELTA as a negative physiological result. These are record/channel descriptors, not window-local measurements.
mask_audit: Compare original all-window cached derivation with derivations using the unchanged original Raw valid mask and independently metadata-derived native-cache complete-window support. Normalize sample bounds by the recorded sampling rate; derive onset position from onset-start+leftPadding, do not assume identical integer units. Report missing fields, boundary disagreements and helper fallback counts. No mask is silently substituted into the existing dataset.
Raw250_audit: Replay the same isolated slope/latency/rank/top20 helper algebra on the already admitted Raw250 pool's actual partial80to125 high-gamma and line-length values with exact original valid masks/times/channel order. This is an unlabeled diagnostic of a distinct retained-band measurement, not an assertion that it recreates the native-cache band or original EDF. No dummy waveforms, low-frequency recovery or full80to150 claim.
permutation_gate: For all matched record channels, reverse channel order, recompute and invert. Require equivariance under the unchanged parity tolerance for any feature to be admitted unchanged as a physiological attribute. Quantify ties, no-crossing fallback and zero pre-SD cases. If onset ranks encode arbitrary order within tied latencies, flag measurement artifact, not biological ineffectiveness. Do not fix/redefine historic rank functions in this audit.
coverage_gate: No selective patient/record/channel omission. All256 records,24995 observed record-channel units, all80 patients/7635 canonical channels and1471965 original valid Raw windows must be accounted for. A descriptor without required valid pre/post or enough slope samples remains partial/unverified rather than dropping that case.
provenance: Read only whitelisted numeric configuration metadata if embedded. Exact original CLI, source-at-cache-creation, acquisition filtering, native spectral support and independent clinical onset stay unknown unless actual evidence proves them. Function-source hash and numerical replay are not substitutes for that provenance.
report: Per-feature/overall/source anonymous finite rates, numeric-replay coverage, mask sensitivity, tie/order failure counts and distribution summaries. These are record/channel descriptive counts, not inferential independent samples. Preserve private per-record diagnostics for reproducibility, export no identifiers/arrays/logs.
stop: Output eligibility decisions only: cached values may be replayable yet unsafe unchanged; a Raw250 valid-mask scalar may be computationally reconstructable but is a distinct candidate requiring separate prospective admission/selection. No feature pool is replaced and no subsequent supervised experiment is automatically authorized. The stable-minimum/Raw-increment objective remains unproven.
